t: What happens to an accusation that does not land
a: لاَ يَرْمِي رَجُلٌ رَجُلاً بِالْفُسُوقِ، وَلاَ يَرْمِيهِ بِالْكُفْرِ، إِلاَّ ارْتَدَّتْ عَلَيْهِ
p: Lā yarmī rajulun rajulan bi-l-fusūq, wa lā yarmīhi bi-l-kufr, illā-rtaddat ʿalayh
m: No man throws the charge of wickedness at another, or throws the charge of disbelief at him, without it coming back on him if his companion is not as he said.
